candidates.text: Let the end be legitimate, let it be within the scope of the Constitution, and all means which are appropriate
candidates.speaker: Marshall

candidates.text: That the power to tax involves the power to destroy; that the power to destroy may defeat and render useless the power to create
candidates.speaker: Marshall
phrases: power to tax involves the power to destroy

candidates.text: Its nature, therefore, requires that only its great outlines should be marked, its important objects designated
candidates.speaker: Marshall

candidates.text: This provision is made in a Constitution intended to endure for ages to come
candidates.speaker: Marshall
phrases: intended to endure for ages to come

candidates.text: The result is a conviction that the States have no power, by taxation or otherwise, to retard, impede, burden
candidates.speaker: Marshall
